title: Cerence AI Honored at JLR’s 2026 Global Supplier Excellence Awards
summary: Cerence AI received JLR’s Exceptional Creator award, recognizing its role in advancing conversational AI, agentic AI, and in-car experiences.
body_markdown:
[Cerence AI](https://www.cerence.com/) was recognized by JLR with its Exceptional Creator award at the automaker’s 2026 Global Supplier Excellence Awards. The category recognizes outstanding partners shaping the future of JLR’s business.


The award reflects the depth of[Cerence AI’s collaboration with JLR](https://investors.cerence.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/109/cerence-ai-signs-long-term-strategic-partnership-to-build-luxury-automakers-next-gen-in-car-experience) , with Cerence bringing[conversational, intelligent AI](https://www.cerence.com/industries/automotive) to JLR’s in-car platform and enabling a more intuitive cabin experience. The close partnership between the two companies has enabled JLR to adopt new AI capabilities with greater speed across areas including agentic AI and immersive voice experiences.


“We are honored to receive JLR’s Exceptional Creator award, which reflects the strength of our partnership and shared vision for the future of in-car experiences,” said Christian Mentz, Chief Revenue Officer, Cerence AI. “Together, we are advancing conversational AI that delivers intuitive, intelligent interactions while enabling JLR to innovate with speed and flexibility.”


“Cerence plays a key role in delivering proactive, conversational intelligence to our customers,” said Tobias Moch, Chief Procurement Officer at JLR. “Our collaboration has evolved in the AI era, with Cerence helping us stay agile, adopt new capabilities with greater speed and confidence, and ultimately deliver a better cabin experience for our customers.”
